body:
I usually don't do trip reports, but since I saw that there weren't any here for this particular combination, I decided to submit this so people have some idea of what to expect if they do it. I can't remember most of the trip, but from what I can, it was good.
I ingested the diphenhydramine (in the form of 6 25mg generic diphedrul capsules) at about 3:30, washing it down with grapefruit juice. This is the second time I've done diphedryl recreationally... strangely, it seemed to be stronger than the first time (250 mg), but with less side effects. I waited until it hit (sometime between 4:30 and 5), then poured 2 bottles of robomax down my throat.
Because of the juice (robomax does not mix well with it in the stomach), I got nausea. The bread I ate must have not soaked enough of it up. Orange juice helped a lot though, so I didn't puke. I paced up and down the basement, because it got worse if I sat down. When the DXM started hitting, I put on headphones and listened to music.
Music sounds incredible on this combination. The enhancement from each drug is very synergistic, and everything just sounds incredible. Visuals also seemed to enhance each other... I got normal OEVs from the diphedryl (lots of spiders, feeling them crawling on me, hanging in front of my face, but it didnt bother me), but the DXM visuals seemed more realistic, with walls covered in eyes and things like that.
My dad came up to carry some stuff up, and I tried to talk to him, but my voice was so slurred he couldn't understand me, and I kept stuttering. He assumed I was drunk and went upstairs, as it was obvious that I wasn't able to converse with him. I then went to bed, and laid there for a while.
As is usually the case with DXM, the trip got really crazy when I went into my windowless bedroom. It's very hard to remember. I couldn't tell whether I was still in my last trip (one I had a week ago), or in another one. I was cut off from my memory. I feel like lots of stuff happened, but I can only remember a small portion of it. Then I apparently fell asleep.
I woke up at 10:30 still tripping, couldn't type the password to unlock my computer, so I went back to sleep, woke up, and wrote this.
The day after the trip, the afterglow from the DXM and the hangover/tiredness from the diphenhydramine are making me very lazy. It feels very good to just lay around and yawn. But, I could go to school/work today without any trouble.
